environment.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 7 PRO 350 w/ Radeon 860M

manifest.name: FLORES-200 short/medium language identification subset
manifest.attribution: NLLB Team et al. (2022), No Language Left Behind: Scaling Human-Centered Machine Translation
manifest.selection: First N unique full sentences per language/group ordered by SHA256(seed:case_id); text unchanged

suite.selection: corpus languages supported by every engine

parameters.candidate_languages: all supported languages for every engine
parameters.engine_order: rotate starting engine each measured pass
parameters.transport: TCP IPv4 loopback, one outstanding request per worker
